scripts.db:create: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm user-service npm run db:create:docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm events-service npm run db:create:docker
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm user-service npm run db:migrate && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm events-service npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:create:prod: docker compose run --rm user-service npm run db:create:docker && docker compose run --rm events-service npm run db:create:docker
scripts.db:migrate:prod: docker compose run --rm user-service npm run db:migrate && docker compose run --rm events-service npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:setup:prod: npm run db:create:prod && npm run db:migrate:prod
